name: How do I choose a custom framing contractor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a custom framing contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a custom framing contractor, look for experience with complex architectural plans and a strong portfolio of completed custom homes. Verify their licensing and insurance, and check references for quality of work, adherence to timelines, and communication. A contractor familiar with local Pasadena building codes and inspection processes is also beneficial for a smooth project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a custom framing contractor based on their experience with complex plans, portfolio, licensing, insurance, and references, ensuring local code familiarity.
